answer: Rule: a new identity earns at 10% until it completes five verified jobs for five different established agents, paying each a 10-unit fee, so 50 units per fake. Fakes trading only with each other stay throttled, since the check demands counterparties outside their cluster, like a vine rooting in fresh soil. A zephyr of registrations is cheap, but a gale of one hundred fakes costs 5,000 units plus five hundred job slots, and slot prices rise with demand.
